nodes.name: Twilio Incoming SMS Webhook
nodes.notes: SETUP: In your Twilio console, set your phone number's 'A Message Comes In' webhook to this URL. Twilio sends POST with Body (message text), From (sender number), To (your Twilio number).

nodes.name: Load Conversation History
nodes.notes: Sheet ID configured. Reads last conversation entries for context.

nodes.name: Send SMS Reply via Twilio
nodes.notes: SETUP: Replace YOUR_TWILIO_PHONE_NUMBER with your Twilio number (e.g., +15551234567)

nodes.name: Respond to Twilio Webhook
nodes.notes: Sends empty TwiML response immediately so Twilio doesn't timeout. The actual reply is sent via the Twilio Send SMS node.
